title.zh: Bitcoin faces 2022 parallels as federal reserve resumes rate hikes
title.en: Bitcoin faces 2022 parallels as federal reserve resumes rate hikes

current_state.zh: The Federal Reserve raised rates by 25bps for the first time in over three years, and Bitcoin's current drawdown mirrors its pre-2022 hiking-cycle position, raising the question of whether a relief rally precedes further losses.
current_state.en: The Federal Reserve raised rates by 25bps for the first time in over three years, and Bitcoin's current drawdown mirrors its pre-2022 hiking-cycle position, raising the question of whether a relief rally precedes further losses.
